set.typical_award_size: $292 million revolving fund (HCD seed $23 million plus $50 million added in 2022). Maximum project loan commitment $13,950,000 (includes fees, interest and acquisition costs). Loan-to-value up to 100% of the lesser of as-is appraised value or purchase price for nonprofit borrowers, 95% for for-profit borrowers. Maximum term five years including extensions; fixed or variable pricing set by the originating lender.
set.affordability_requirement: Rental: 100% of units at or below 60% AMI. Homeownership: at or below 80% AMI. Mixed-use or mixed-income: at least 75% of square footage or units affordable at or below 60% AMI, otherwise loan amount is adjusted. Regulatory agreement recorded to maintain long-term affordability.
eligible_project_detail: Acquisition of vacant land or improved property in California for affordable rental or homeownership development
Borrowers: nonprofit or for-profit developers, cities, counties, other California public agencies and joint ventures with an affordable housing track record
Term sheet covers acquisition loans only; predevelopment is not listed as a use
